text: The Patriots are preparing for a pivotal AFC East divisional showdown against the Jets while processing the loss of Jon Morris, the Hall of Fame center who anchored the franchise for 11 seasons and was inducted into the Patriots Hall of Fame in 2011—Morris, who played 11 of his 15-year AFL and NFL career in New England, passed away at 84. Coming off their best performance of the season, a dominant 28-point victory, the Patriots are looking to extend their winning streak to three games, though they'll need to navigate the Jets' blitz-heavy defensive scheme at Gillette Stadium on Sunday; meanwhile, the status of star wide receiver A.J. Brown remains uncertain after he returned to practice this week with his availability still "up in the air." The Jets, sitting at 2-3, arrive for their first divisional game of the season knowing the importance of the matchup for the standings, with pass rusher Garrett Wilson calling it a "big-ass game," while the Patriots must also contend with Geno Smith, who has brought an impressive no-interception streak into the AFC East showdown.
